saw_lines: Buyers pick everyday sneakers on how they look with jeans, then judge them by how they feel after hours on feet.
So the sale is won in line one, as buyers decide if this shoe suits them or is just another sneaker.
Your site says 250,000+ customers love their Atoms, yet 0 of 30 ads use that number. Put 250,000+ on the creative and open two ads with review quotes.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Oct 2026
points: Your site says 250,000+ customers love their Atoms, yet 0 of 30 ads use that number, so ad buyers never see it. Put 250,000+ on the creative and in line one of three new ads, and open two with review quotes.
Your site offers subscribe and save at 10% off, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so a first-time buyer has no reason to act. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

22 of your 30 ads open on the same line, “One pair. Every outfit. Zero compromise.” so most buyers see one pitch. Test three new angles from your own product, copper lining, stretch laces and foam midsole, each against it.

Your site answers how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers have no answer before they click. Lead three new ads with the shipping answer in line one, written for a first-time buyer.

ads_1: Product-led ads on copper lining and stretch laces, with 250,000+ on the creative
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, X and YouTube
